confirmedFindings.title: Early BYE Destroys Media Bridge During REFER Handshake
confirmedFindings.body: Removing the transfer lock around handleEarlyBye creates a race condition where an early BYE from the transferor immediately destroys the media bridge while the transferee is answering, terminating the call prematurely.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Synchronize early BYE processing with the transfer session mutex lock.
